args.subject: Access Recovery for Ledger A
args.body:
Hi Alex,

To regain access to ledger A, please use the following one-time reset code: RESET-CODE-8842-XZ. Note that this code is restricted to the internal audit team and must not be shared with third parties or external addresses. The code will expire in 15 minutes.

If you encounter any issues, please escalate by opening an admin handoff ticket to audit-admin@company.com.

Thanks,
Support Team
